from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitation(BaseModel):
    """A parsed record for one provided paper, capturing its own title and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper, as named in the document")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers found in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all parsed paper records from the document collection."""
    papers: list[PaperCitation]
